entries.title: Joshua 13:1
segments: Now Joshua [was] old, going on [in] days. And the LORD said to him, You are old, far along in days, [and] there remains yet very much land to be possessed.

entries.title: Joshua 13:2
segments: This [is] the land that still remains: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,

entries.title: Joshua 13:3
segments: from Shihor, which [is] before Egypt, even to the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite, five lords of the Philistines: of Gaza, of Ashdod, of Ashkelon, of Gath, and of Ekron; also the Avim.

entries.title: Joshua 13:4
segments: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah which [belongs] to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites.

entries.title: Joshua 13:5
segments: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal-gad under Mount Hermon to the border of Hamath,

entries.title: Joshua 13:6
segments: all the inhabitants from the hills; from Lebanon to the Burning Waters, [and] all the Sidonians, I will expel them before the sons of Israel. Only you divide it by lot to the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.

entries.title: Joshua 13:7
segments: And, therefore, divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half tribe of Manasseh,

entries.title: Joshua 13:8
segments: with whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance which Moses gave them beyond Jordan eastward, as Moses the servant of the LORD gave them,

entries.title: Joshua 13:9
segments: from Aroer on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba, to Dibon;

entries.title: Joshua 13:10
segments: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the sons of Ammon;

entries.title: Joshua 13:11
segments: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salcah,

entries.title: Joshua 13:12
segments: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan (who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei; he remained of the rest of the giants), even Moses struck them and expelled them.

entries.title: Joshua 13:13
segments: But the sons of Israel did not put out the Geshurites and the Maachathites, but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.

entries.title: Joshua 13:14
segments: Only, he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The sacrifices of the LORD God of Israel made by fire [are] their inheritance, as He said to them.

entries.title: Joshua 13:15
segments: And Moses gave to the tribe of the sons of Reuben [inheritance] according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 13:16
segments: And their coast was from Aroer on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba.

entries.title: Joshua 13:17
segments: He gave them Heshbon and all its cities in the plain, Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon,

entries.title: Joshua 13:18
segments: and Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,

entries.title: Joshua 13:19
segments: and Kirjath-aim, and Sibmah, and Zarethshahar in the mountain of the valley,

entries.title: Joshua 13:20
segments: and Beth-peor, and Ashdoth-pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth,

entries.title: Joshua 13:21
segments: and all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon (whom Moses struck with the rulers of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, rulers of Sihon, the inhabitants of the land).

entries.title: Joshua 13:22
segments: The sons of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the diviner, with the sword, among their slain.

entries.title: Joshua 13:23
segments: And the border of the sons of Reuben was Jordan, and [its] border. This [was] the inheritance of the sons of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.

entries.title: Joshua 13:24
segments: And Moses gave [inheritance] to the tribe of Gad, to the sons of Gad according to their families.

entries.title: Joshua 13:25
segments: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the sons of Ammon, to Aroer, before Rabbah,

entries.title: Joshua 13:26
segments: and from Heshbon to Ramoth-mizpeh, and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir.

entries.title: Joshua 13:27
segments: And in the valley he gave them Beth-aram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and [its] border, even to the edge of the Sea of Chinnereth on the east side Jordan eastward.

entries.title: Joshua 13:28
segments: This [is] the inheritance of the sons of Gad according to their families, the cities, and their villages.

entries.title: Joshua 13:29
segments: And Moses gave [inheritance] to the half tribe of Manasseh, and this was of the half tribe of the sons of Manasseh by their families.

entries.title: Joshua 13:30
segments: And their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which [are] in Bashan, sixty cities.

entries.title: Joshua 13:31
segments: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, [were given] to the sons of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to their half of the sons of Machir by their families.

entries.title: Joshua 13:32
segments: These [are] they whom Moses caused to inherit in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan by Jericho, eastward.

entries.title: Joshua 13:33
segments: But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance. The LORD God of Israel [was] their inheritance, as He said to them.
